about_the_game:
Idlemon is an idle desktop animal trainer. Played on the side of your screen, your animals will gain experience, level up and grow stronger. Fight other animals, get gold, buy items, and acquire new training buddies.

Train

On your island the animals will train, attacking the practice dummy to gain experience overtime. When reached the threshold your animals will level up, allowing you to use skill points to increase chosen statistics.

Fight

Travel to other islands to fight hostile animals. This gives you more experience and gold, used to purchase and upgrade items to buff your animals. Watch out for the eggs, as they have a chance to drop and hatch a new animal you can train.

Don Let It Stop You From Work!

Idlemon let's you get invested in a new experience without the need to pay attention to it. Put it anywhere on your screen, resize or even turn on transparency mode if in need to get something done. No such thing as pausing.
